SELECT nm.id, nm.name, nm.type, nm.depth, nm.image_url, nm.parent_id, nm.target_id, nm.sort_weight, nm.created_time, nm.is_enable AS enable, pnm.name AS parentName
FROM navigation_menu AS nm LEFT JOIN navigation_menu AS pnm ON nm.parent_id = pnm.id
AND nm.is_deleted = 0
AND nm.`name` LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.name}, '%')
AND nm.`type` = #{dto.type}
AND nm.`depth` = #{dto.depth}
AND nm.`is_enable` = ${dto.enable ? 1 : 0}
AND nm.`merchant_id` = #{dto.merchantId}
AND nm.`merchant_id` = 0
ORDER BY
nm.`depth` ${dto.sortByDepth ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'},
nm.`sort_weight` ${dto.sortByWeight ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'},
nm.`created_time` ${dto.sortByCreatedTime ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'},
nm.`id` DESC

WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT id, name, depth, image_url, parent_id, target_id, sort_weight
FROM navigation_menu
WHERE is_enable = 1 AND parent_id = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 AND type = #{type} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
UNION ALL
SELECT nm.id, nm.name, nm.depth, nm.image_url, nm.parent_id, nm.target_id, nm.sort_weight
FROM navigation_menu AS nm INNER JOIN tree ON nm.parent_id = tree.id
WHERE nm.is_enable = 1 AND nm.is_deleted = 0 AND nm.type = #{type})
SELECT tree.id, tree.name, tree.depth, tree.image_url, tree.parent_id, tree.target_id, tree.sort_weight
FROM tree ORDER BY tree.depth, tree.sort_weight
